description.zh:
流程定义，遵循Flow Definition Language (FDL)语法标准。考虑到向前兼容，当系统支持两种规范的流程定义规范。

> 
> 以上流程定义示例中Name：my_flow_name是指流程名称，需和入参Name保持一致
description.en:
The definition of the flow. It must comply with the Flow Definition Language (FDL) syntax. For forward compatibility, the system supports two versions of the flow definition specification.

> In the example flow definitions, Name: my\_flow\_name refers to the flow name and must be the same as the Name input parameter.

description.zh: 配置 Flow 执行期间可以访问的环境信息
description.en: The environment context that the flow can access during execution.

description.zh: 执行模式，枚举类型，可以是Express和Standard；考虑到向前兼容，空串等价于Standard 执行模式。
description.en: The execution mode. This is an enumeration type. Valid values are Express and Standard. For forward compatibility, an empty string is treated as the Standard execution mode.

description.zh:
流程名称。该名称在同一地域内唯一，创建后不可修改。取值说明如下：

- 支持英文字符（a~z）或（A~Z）、数字（0~9）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
- 首字母必须为英文字母（a~z）、（A~Z）或下划线（_）。
- 区分大小写。
- 长度为1~128个字符。
description.en:
The name of the flow. The name must be unique within the same region and cannot be changed after the flow is created. The name must meet the following requirements:

- It can contain letters (a to z and A to Z), digits (0 to 9), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

- It must start with a letter or an underscore (\_).

- It is case-sensitive.

- It must be 1 to 128 characters in length.

description.zh: 流程执行依赖的授权角色资源描述符信息。用于在执行流程时，Serverless 工作流服务扮演该角色（AssumeRole）操作相关的流程资源。
description.en: The resource descriptor for the role that the flow relies on for execution. When the flow runs, Serverless Workflow assumes this role (AssumeRole) to operate on related flow resources.
The type of the flow. The value must be **FDL**.

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明
- 每个用户所能创建的流程个数受资源限制（详见[使用限制](~~122093~~)），如果您有特殊需求，可以提工单进行调整。
- 流程在用户级别是按照名称来区分的，即单一账号下不可以存在同名流程。
descriptions.en:
## Description

- The number of flows that each user can create is subject to resource limits. For more information, see [Limits](~~122093~~). If you have special requirements, submit a ticket to request a limit adjustment.

- Flows are uniquely identified by name within an account. Therefore, you cannot create multiple flows with the same name under a single account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun fnf create-flow --name my_flow_name --definition 'Legacy_version:_type:_flow_version:_v1_name:_my_flow_name_steps:_ -_type:_pass_ name:_mypass_New_version:_Type:_StateMachine_SpecVersion:_v1_Name:_my_flow_name_StartAt:_my_state_States:_ -_Type:_Pass_ Name:_my_state_ End:_true' --description my_test_flow --type FDL --role-arn acs:ram:_region_:_accountID_:_role --external-storage-location /path --execution-mode Standard --environment '{"Variables":[{"Description":"description","Value":"value","Name":"key"}]}' --resource-group-id example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun fnf CreateFlow --region cn-hangzhou --Type FDL --Description my_test_flow --ResourceGroupId 'example-string' --Definition 'Legacy_version:_type:_flow_version:_v1_name:_my_flow_name_steps:_ -_type:_pass_ name:_mypass_New_version:_Type:_StateMachine_SpecVersion:_v1_Name:_my_flow_name_StartAt:_my_state_States:_ -_Type:_Pass_ Name:_my_state_ End:_true' --Environment '{"Variables":[{"Description":"description","Value":"value","Name":"key"}]}' --ExecutionMode Standard --ExternalStorageLocation '/path' --RoleArn 'acs:ram:_region_:_accountID_:_role' --Name my_flow_name
